title: COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( table ) ) counts the blank row

source.quote: the VALUES function treats the blank row as a regular row, returning it. On the other hand, DISTINCT never returns the blank row
source.supports: VALUES returns the blank row as a regular row

source.quote: returns a table with the same columns and all the rows of the table (including duplicates) with the additional blank row caused by an invalid relationship if present
source.supports: VALUES of a table adds the blank row

derivation: Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so the relationship is invalid and Product gets a blank row. 3 stored rows + the blank row = 4.
